meta.scope: Vietnam Batch 7 — Banking and financial system densification: structure of credit institutions, total assets, credit growth, non-performing loans, and monetary/credit indicators.

candidates.title: Structure and total assets of credit institutions
candidates.description: Official statistics on the structure of the credit-institution system (state-owned commercial banks, joint-stock commercial banks, foreign banks, policy banks, finance companies, people’s credit funds, etc.) and their total assets, charter capital and key ratios.
candidates.notes: Core structural node for the Vietnamese banking system.

candidates.title: State-owned commercial banks (SOCBs) statistics
candidates.description: Statistics focused on the major state-owned commercial banks (Vietcombank, VietinBank, BIDV, Agribank and related). These institutions hold a large share of system assets and play a central role in credit allocation.

candidates.title: Credit growth and outstanding loans statistics
candidates.description: System-wide and sectoral credit growth rates and outstanding loan volumes. Credit expansion is a key transmission channel of monetary policy and a major driver of investment and consumption.
referenced_by: SBV monetary policy and banking-system nodes

candidates.title: Non-performing loans and asset-quality statistics
candidates.publisher: State Bank of Vietnam / commercial bank disclosures
candidates.description: System-wide and bank-level non-performing loan ratios, absolute NPL volumes and loan-loss provisioning / coverage ratios. Key indicator of banking-system health and credit risk.

candidates.title: Monetary aggregates and key SBV monetary indicators
candidates.description: Money supply, deposit and other monetary aggregates that complement credit statistics and feed monetary-policy analysis.
candidates.notes: Monetary densification of the central-bank cluster.

candidates.title: Policy and development banking institutions (VBSP and related)
candidates.publisher: Vietnam Bank for Social Policies / SBV related
candidates.description: Statistics and institutional role of the Vietnam Bank for Social Policies and other policy-oriented credit institutions that target poverty reduction, rural development and social objectives.
candidates.notes: Policy-banking densification linking finance to social objectives.

candidates.title: Vietnam banking and financial-system densification meta-node
candidates.description: Meta-node binding the structure and total assets of credit institutions, state-owned commercial banks, credit growth, non-performing loans, monetary aggregates and policy-banking institutions into a coherent banking and financial-system layer.
referenced_by: All detailed nodes in this batch
SBV institutional core, BOP and macro series from earlier batches
candidates.notes: Integrating node for the banking densification pass.
